intro: Scaber Stalks are rare mushrooms that flourish in the damp, secluded cavern hidden behind Cliffspring Falls in Darkshore. Prized by herbalists and alchemists for their unusual properties, they are sought by Barithras Moonshade for his concoctions.

p: Scaber Stalks are obscure mushrooms found deep within the cavern nestled behind Cliffspring Falls, situated along the northeastern mountains of Darkshore. Unlike ordinary forest flora, these pale stalks thrive strictly in the secluded dampness of the subterranean cave network. Their remote and hazardous habitat makes gathering them exceedingly rare, leading alchemists like Barithras Moonshade in Auberdine to commission daring scouts willing to brave the dark.
